title: The Easiest Way to Build a Local Newsletter
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Host says he loves Beehiiv, has used it 2 years and is trying to invest in it; walkthrough is Beehiiv-centric

idea.name: Local email newsletter grown with Meta lead ads
idea.one_liner: Pick any 50K+ town, launch a Beehiiv newsletter, buy subscribers with Facebook instant-form lead ads (~$1 each), then sell CPM sponsorships to local businesses among the subscribers
idea.offer: weekly local news, events and deals
idea.revenue_model: sponsor ads at $20-100 CPM, plus Beehiiv ad network, boosts, paid tiers, merch

key_quotes.quote: Over time, this will get even more and more optimized and we'll be acquiring subs, subscribers for 40 to 50 cents.
You can charge between 20 and $100 CPM, cost per mill, cost per thousand eyeballs.
So, your sponsors are your subscribers.

claims.claim: 8 leads for $9 within ~10 minutes of launch, no audience help
claims.quote: Guys, we freaking we legitimately have 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 We have eight freaking leads already.
Okay, that means I can make $250 per send or $1,250 per week.

claims.claim: Each subscriber worth ~$12 over a 2-year life
claims.quote: 50 cents a month time 24 months is $12.

claims.claim: Over 50% fill in onboarding survey if sent immediately
claims.quote: In my experience, over 50% of people fill those surveys out because they're hot to trot.

acquisition_channels.details: Meta lead ads, instant form email-only, $100 day one then ~$20/day, geo-targeted
referral program with low first threshold

ideas.delivery: Beehiiv website+newsletter templates, Zapier connects FB leads to Beehiiv, ChatGPT for research and ad copy
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR/PECR require proper consent and a genuine privacy policy for email sign-ups (he linked a random one); CAP Code ad labelling

idea.name: Naptown Scoop (Annapolis local newsletter)
idea.one_liner: Friend's Beehiiv local newsletter monetised with sponsors and local business announcements

key_quotes.quote: First of all, he's got a sponsor up here, which means he's making money.
